title: Crude Membrane Fractionation of Cultured Cells
author: Asad Malik

steps.title: Seed and wash cells
steps.instruction: Use one 15 cm dish of HEK293 cells (~1.8 × 10⁷ cells). Remove media, aspirate completely, then wash twice with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS.

steps.title: Serum‑starve and PMA treat
steps.instruction: Serum‑starve the cells for 16 h, then add phorbol myristic acid (PMA) at 100 ng/mL (or leave untreated) for 30 min.

steps.title: Place dishes on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the dishes to ice using wet paper‑towel‑covered steel blocks resting on ice.

steps.title: Scrape cells into tube
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL ice‑cold PBS, scrape cells with a cell lifter (e.g., Sigma‑Aldrich CLS3008 or equivalent), and collect the suspension in a 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 100 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; aspirate and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in Buffer A
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 400 µL Buffer A by gentle pipetting, transfer to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, and incubate on ice for 15 min (5 min may be sufficient).

steps.title: Add Buffer B
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL cold Buffer B to the suspension.

steps.title: Homogenize with needle
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 25‑gauge needle attached to a 1 mL syringe 25 times; monitor breakage by microscopy (6–10 passes may be sufficient).

steps.title: Low‑speed spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; transfer the supernatant (post‑nuclear supernatant) to a new 1.5 mL tube. Keep the pellet (nuclei/debris) on ice for optional lysis in 500 µL Buffer C.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge membranes
steps.instruction: Load the post‑nuclear supernatant into thick‑walled polycarbonate ultracentrifuge tubes and spin at 150,000 × g, 4 °C for 20 min; a membrane pellet forms at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Collect cytosolic fraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (cytosolic fraction) to a fresh Eppendorf tube kept on ice.

steps.title: Wash membrane pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane pellet three times with 500 µL PBS, aspirating completely after each wash.

steps.title: Solubilize membrane proteins
steps.instruction: Resuspend the membrane pellet in 500 µL Buffer C, incubate on ice for 5–20 min to allow detergent solubilization.

steps.title: Separate soluble membrane proteins
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; collect the supernatant (solubilized membrane proteins) and keep the insoluble pellet aside.

steps.title: Measure protein concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration of all lysates by Bradford assay according to the manufacturer’s instructions, performing measurements in triplicate; ensure samples are within the linear range (≥2 µg/µL for near‑confluent cells) and dilute with water if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare SDS‑PAGE samples
steps.instruction: Add 4× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer to each sample containing 5 µg membrane protein or an equivalent volume of cytosolic protein, then heat at 37 °C for 10 min.
